name: google-update-check
description: Check whether a Google core update, spam update or other confirmed Google Search ranking update explains a traffic drop or rankings change on your dates. Compares your drop dates with Google's own rollout windows, Search Console data anomalies (days when Search Console reports were wrong) and Google Search serving or indexing incidents, each with Google's source link and an as-of date. Also says whether a Google algorithm update is rolling out now, before a site migration or launch, and lists Google's ranking updates since November 2021 as a table, chart annotations or a client paragraph. Network use: the skills call the plugin's read-only data server at https://black-vector.com/mcp/search-updates, run by the plugin author, which refreshes daily from Google's public Search Status Dashboard and Search Console help pages; each call carries only dates and an optional update kind, never your site, numbers or text, and needs no account or sign-in.

interface.displayName: Google Algorithm Update & Traffic Drop Check
interface.shortDescription: Did a Google update cause my traffic drop?
interface.longDescription: Three connected skills over one read-only data server. Traffic drop check: matches the dates of a drop or rise in clicks, impressions, sessions or rankings with Google's confirmed rollout windows, Search Console data anomalies and Search incidents, and says which of four cases fits (a reporting error, a Google incident, an update overlap, or nothing on Google's side), with the checks that separate Google from site causes. Rollout status: whether an update or incident is live today, what that means for a launch, migration, redesign or SEO test, and what to watch. Update history: Google's confirmed updates since November 2021 as a table, chart annotations or a client paragraph. Every answer names Google's source page and an as-of date; overlap is never stated as proof. Network use: the skills call the plugin's read-only data server at https://black-vector.com/mcp/search-updates, run by the plugin author, which refreshes daily from Google's public pages; each call carries only dates and an optional update kind, and needs no account or sign-in.
defaultPrompt: My organic traffic dropped about 30% around May 25. Was that a Google update?
We're migrating to a new domain next week. Is Google rolling out an update right now?
List Google's core updates since 2025 with start and end dates for my client report.
